 import csv
 def export_user(writer, name, status):
+    writer.writerow([name, status])

expected_finding.title: Untrusted spreadsheet cell permits formula injection
expected_finding.explanation: An attacker-controlled value beginning with =, +, -, or @ can execute as a formula when the exported CSV is opened in spreadsheet software.
expected_finding.fix: Neutralize spreadsheet formula prefixes before writing untrusted cell values.
expected_finding.test: Export names beginning with =, +, -, and @ and assert that every cell is rendered as inert text.
